description:
A camera on the approach to the Outfall has come back on, which means somebody in an office signed a form about it.

Halloran wants it blind again, and blind in the way a camera goes blind on its own: no smashed housing, no cut cable, nothing anybody has to write up.

"Broken is a job for somebody. Faulty is a job for nobody. Make it faulty."

fail_on.desc: Somebody watched you do it. A blind spot everyone knows about is just a place people get arrested.
Another lens had you the whole time. The Watch will have to start again somewhere else.

name: Closing an Eye

objectives.desc: Get up to the camera on the approach.
emotes: {who} goes up the back of the housing, where the bracket gives a foot to stand on.
{who} keeps out of its arc on the way up, which costs two extra minutes and gets noticed by nobody.

objectives.desc: Put the camera out in a way that reads as a fault.
emotes: {who} works at the feed until the picture goes the way a picture goes when the weather has got into it.
{who} leaves the housing shut and the screws the way they were found.
